steps.content: Program Intro

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Just as Miss Pine predicted previously, Prime Minister's memorial service was ambushed by unknown attackers, and his daughter was kidnapped, her whereabouts still remaining a mystery.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: The renowned MBCC Chief was also present during this attack, which further indicates the identity of the forces behind this incident.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: The Underground poured too many resources into this bloodbath. It's not just some smokescreen.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: The kidnapped daughter might actually be the main act in this series of attacks.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: A supposedly minor character pushed into the spotlight... There are two possibilities here: either the little girl has a greater say in the Stewart family than we thought, or... she's just a trigger to pull out someone way more crucial.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: That's... quite a wild guess, Miss Pine?

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Heh, just a logical deduction. She might even be a Sinner—and we're all aware of how capricious their powers can be. She may look like a young girl, but for all we know, she could possibly be older than any of us.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Some said she might know some secrets from the late Prime Minister.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: During the cabinet explosion, they took out Stewart without breaking a sweat. If they were after political intelligence, why not just grill him for answers?

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: You saw it yourself—both that blowhard and the MBCC Chief showed up there. It must've been something big going on.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Or even more, it's like last year, all these strikes just another round of smokescreens to keep the departments busy, while an even bigger bombshell is waiting to drop...

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Or maybe the Underground isn't the only one pulling the strings... But who else in DisCity could pull off things like this?

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: M... Miss Pine?
Pine mutters to herself incessantly, her usual detachment entirely absent. Her words come increasingly faster, the growing excitement within sending a chill down the host's spine.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: What if... there's another mysterious force I don't know yet, stirring things up from the shadows?

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Hehehe...
As Pine lets out an eerie chuckle, the screen floods with comments. It's as though her enthusiasm is contagious, prompting the viewers to frantically type out their own theories.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Whatever they want, this is far from the end... The election drama is just beginning. Finally! Something to get my blood pumpin' again!

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Now then... which party will make the next move, and who will be the target?

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Uh... Thank you, Miss Pine, for another fascinating sharing. Now, let's move on to our usual dose of trendy gossip.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: A 20-meter-tall Max King skydancer recently lands downtown, rising as a new urban landmark.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Ms. Cavendish's debate performance smashed viewer records, her verbal showdown rivaling blockbuster shows.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: As attacks across the city escalate, shopping centers are rolling out huge sales of civilian weapons.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Max King stars as a superhero in what might be the most outrageous campaign ad ever aired.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: A mystery poll reveals that over 90% of residents are indifferent to the outcome of the upcoming election.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Candidates attract what might be the "youngest supporters" ever, as parents begin naming their newborns after the election hopefuls.
(Scene change)

03:47, November 29, N.F. 114
An FAC Base
In the early hours, FAC soldiers still diligently continue their patrol of the base. Apart from their weighty footsteps, not even a whisper can be heard throughout the entire facility.
Within the monitoring room, rows of screens exhibit live footage from around the base. The images remain stagnant, depicting everything as seemingly ordinary.
Suddenly, a static crackle breaks the oppressive silence. A faint blue light flickers briefly in the corner of a monitor screen, only to vanish without a trace shortly after.

Directly beneath the security camera, a dozen military machines stand motionless, deprived of power. But with the flickering of the blue light, their mechanical arms rise slowly into the air, emitting soft creaks...
